---
title: Gerrymandering Metrics
format: typst
---

### 2024 Election Results and the 2024 District Map

```{r}
election_metrics <- merged |>
    filter(district_type == "CNG", votes > 0) |>
    group_by(CDDIST) |>
    summarize(
        total_district_votes = first(total_votes),
        dem_votes = sum(votes[grepl("dem", race_type)]),
        rep_votes = sum(votes[grepl("rep", race_type)]),
        dem_vote_share = dem_votes / (dem_votes + rep_votes),
        rep_vote_share = rep_votes / (dem_votes + rep_votes),
        dem_won = dem_votes > rep_votes
    ) |>
ungroup()

# MEAN MEDIAN
mean_dem_share <- mean(election_metrics$dem_vote_share)

# Median vote share
median_dem_share <- median(election_metrics$dem_vote_share)

# Mean-median score
mean_median_score <- mean_dem_share - median_dem_share

cat("Mean Democratic Vote Share:", round(mean_dem_share * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Median Democratic Vote Share:", round(median_dem_share * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Mean-Median Score:", round(mean_median_score * 100, 2), "%\n")
if (mean_median_score > 0) {
    cat("Interpretation: Small Democratic advantage (mean > median)\n\n")
} else {
    cat("Interpretation: Small Republican advantage (mean < median)\n\n")
}

# EFFICIENCY GAP
election_metrics <- election_metrics %>%
    mutate(
        vote_margin = abs(dem_votes - rep_votes),
        dem_wasted = if_else(
            dem_won,
            dem_votes - (dem_votes + rep_votes) / 2,
            dem_votes
        ),
        rep_wasted = if_else(
            !dem_won,
            rep_votes - (dem_votes + rep_votes) / 2,
            rep_votes
        )
    )

total_dem_wasted <- sum(election_metrics$dem_wasted)
total_rep_wasted <- sum(election_metrics$rep_wasted)
total_votes_cast <- sum(election_metrics$dem_votes + election_metrics$rep_votes)
efficiency_gap <- (total_rep_wasted - total_dem_wasted) / total_votes_cast

cat("EFFICIENCY GAP")
cat("Total Democratic Wasted Votes:", format(total_dem_wasted, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Total Republican Wasted Votes:", format(total_rep_wasted, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Efficiency Gap:", round(efficiency_gap * 100, 2), "%\n")
if (abs(efficiency_gap) < 0.08) {
    cat("Interpretation: Within acceptable range (< 8%)\n")
} else if (efficiency_gap > 0) {
    cat("Interpretation: Republicans have an efficiency advantage (wasting fewer votes)\n")
} else {
    cat("Interpretation: Democrats have an efficiency advantage (wasting fewer votes)\n")
}

cat("\nWon:\n")
cat("Democrats:", sum(election_metrics$dem_won), "seats\n")
cat("Republicans:", sum(!election_metrics$dem_won), "seats\n")
```


### 2024 Election Results and the proposed 2025 District Map

```{r}
election_metrics <- district_votes %>%
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = party,
        values_from = total_votes,
        values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        dem_votes = house_dem,
        rep_votes = house_rep,
        total_district_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
        dem_vote_share = dem_votes / (dem_votes + rep_votes),
        rep_vote_share = rep_votes / (dem_votes + rep_votes),
        dem_won = dem_votes >= rep_votes
    )

# MEAN MEDIAN
mean_dem_share <- mean(election_metrics$dem_vote_share, na.rm = TRUE)

# Median vote share
median_dem_share <- median(election_metrics$dem_vote_share, na.rm = TRUE)

# Mean-median score
mean_median_score <- mean_dem_share - median_dem_share

cat("MEAN-MEDIAN ANALYSIS\n")
cat("Mean Democratic Vote Share:", round(mean_dem_share * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Median Democratic Vote Share:", round(median_dem_share * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Mean-Median Score:", round(mean_median_score * 100, 2), "%\n")

# EFFICIENCY GAP
election_metrics <- election_metrics %>%
    mutate(
        vote_margin = abs(dem_votes - rep_votes),
        dem_wasted = if_else(
            dem_won,
            dem_votes - (dem_votes + rep_votes) / 2,
            dem_votes
        ),
        rep_wasted = if_else(
            !dem_won,
            rep_votes - (dem_votes + rep_votes) / 2,
            rep_votes
        )
    )

total_dem_wasted <- sum(election_metrics$dem_wasted, na.rm = TRUE)
total_rep_wasted <- sum(election_metrics$rep_wasted, na.rm = TRUE)
total_votes_cast <- sum(election_metrics$dem_votes + election_metrics$rep_votes, na.rm = TRUE)
efficiency_gap <- (total_rep_wasted - total_dem_wasted) / total_votes_cast

cat("EFFICIENCY GAP\n")
cat("Total Democratic Wasted Votes:", format(round(total_dem_wasted), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Total Republican Wasted Votes:", format(round(total_rep_wasted), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Efficiency Gap:", round(efficiency_gap * 100, 2), "%\n")

cat("SEATS WON\n")
cat("Democrats:", sum(election_metrics$dem_won, na.rm = TRUE), "seats\n")
cat("Republicans:", sum(!election_metrics$dem_won, na.rm = TRUE), "seats\n")
cat("Total Districts:", nrow(election_metrics), "\n")
```
